001037c0.name: Heap::setMark
001037c0.why: (heap, i): mark i = the end of the last block (+0x14 tail: addr + size & 0x3fffffff); i = -1 sets all four marks

00103870.name: Heap::markedUsage
00103870.why: (heap, i): mark i (+0x1c + 4i) minus the heap base +4, at least 0; GameSystem::flipFrame shows marks 0..2 of the global heap as bars

001038a0.name: Heap::realloc
001038a0.why: (heap, ptr, size): under the heap semaphore, keeps the block when its size (header -0x10, +4 & 0x3fffffff) already fits, else moves it to a bigger block (rest of the body not read in detail); PtrList::add uses it

00103aa0.name: Heap::free
00103aa0.why: (heap, p): WaitSema(heap+0) when >= 0, unlink block p-0x10 (0x103b10), SignalSema; heap object 0x329970 serves operator delete; may be MSL's pool allocator, class name provisional

00103b10.name: Heap::freeBlock
00103b10.why: the unlocked body of Heap::free and Heap::realloc's move path: header at ptr - 0x10, drops its gap record, unlinks it from the address-ordered list (+0x10 head / +0x14 tail), drops the new tail's gap record or records the grown gap after the previous block, count +0x18 down (0 clears head and tail)

00103c50.name: Heap::alloc
00103c50.why: (heap, size, align): same semaphore guard around 0x103cd0; operator new passes align 16

00103cd0.name: Heap::allocBlock
00103cd0.why: the unlocked body of Heap::alloc (heap, size, align) and Heap::realloc's move path: room = header (align * ((align + 0xf) / align)) + size rounded to align; empty heap -> after nothing; mode byte +0x34 clear: the gap list +0x38, then the space before the head, then the blocks from the tail back; mode set: after the tail, then the gap list; sets the size, records the new gap, raises the four marks +0x1c; returns the user pointer

00104150.name: Heap::unlinkGap
00104150.why: (heap, block): when the block's size word has bit 31, the record at its data end rounded to 16 with magic 0x7381a9bc is unlinked from the gap list +0x38 / +0x3c and the bit cleared; returns 1 when one was

00104230.name: Heap::linkGap
00104230.why: (heap, block): when the space between the block's data end (rounded to 16) and the next block is at least +0x40 (0x40), writes a record {0x7381a9bc, block, prev, next} at that end, appends it to the gap list +0x38 / +0x3c and sets bit 31 of the size word; the tail and already-recorded blocks are skipped

001043a0.name: Heap::insertBlock
001043a0.why: (heap, prev, align): places a block header right after prev's data (the heap base when prev is null) with the user pointer aligned and at least 0x10 past it, links it after prev (or as the head), count +0x18 up and the peak +0x2c; returns the header

00104500.name: Heap::init
00104500.why: (heap, base, size), from initGlobalHeap on 0x329970: CreateSema (init 1, max 1) into +0, base +4, end +8, size +0xc, every list / mark / count zero, mode byte +0x34 0, minimum recorded gap +0x40 = 0x40

001045a0.name: shutdownGlobalHeap
001045a0.why: main's teardown: DeleteSema(heap 0x329970 +0), _free_r(_impure_ptr, heap memory +4); undoes initGlobalHeap

00104600.name: initGlobalHeap
00104600.why: (size, <= 0 means all but -size): sizes free RAM from 0x31a880..0x31a888 (else 32 MB - end - 0x2000), probes with _malloc_r / _free_r, then _malloc_r's block becomes the heap 0x329970 (0x104500)

001046b0.name: randNext
001046b0.why: the RNG step: picks the shuffle slot 0x3299c0[prev % 97], refills it from the LCG 0x31a88c * 0x5d588b65 + 1 and returns the old value >> 1; randUnit 0x104720 is its float form
